### What's new

- **Updated to NDI® 6.3.2** (previously 6.1.1). The bundled NDI runtime now includes the latest fixes from Vizrt, among them improved SpeedHQ rate control. Nothing changes for you: receivers on any NDI 6.x version keep working, and you don't need to install anything extra. The NDI runtime is included in the app.

### Download

**macOS 13+** (Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized): download **`WBWrite-1.0.1.dmg`**, open it and drag WBWrite into Applications, replacing the old version.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
